先复习关键方法，再完成一组匹配当前难度的变式题。: Review the key method, then attempt variations at a suitable difficulty.
完成限时收尾训练: Practise finishing within the time limit
按真实平均题时作答，预留最后检查时间并记录未完成题。: Work to the paper's average question time, allow time for checking and record unfinished questions.
重做近期失分题，确认正确率回升不是单次波动。: Redo recent mistakes to check that improved accuracy is sustained.
固定套卷计时偏离有效区间，需校准前段速度和末段检查时间。: Paper timing falls outside the useful range. Adjust early pacing and final checking time.
最近证据已过期: Practice evidence is out of date
接近就绪，先清除剩余风险: Nearly ready; address the remaining risks
当前仍有影响整卷表现的缺口: Some gaps still affect paper performance
保持真实计时与一次提交，考后只复盘高价值失分。: Keep full timing and a single submission, then focus your review on the most useful lost marks.
